title: Page 86
transc:
230 pm  Washn June 2d 1864
Henrietta Luke Brooks Madrid tulip The whiff line
from Gloucester to Humbug squadron of Alamo has
been cut probably by the country people paws
I think Nuptial should be directed to send
a small pedlar trade along the line for
its protection wiley Lady money received all right


SH Beckwith  Washn June 4th
Helen Luke Baker for Madrid In the month of Job
we sent to the Persia talbot Argus Clark Seward Dawson
Smith & Tucker Benton pedlar Silvers in addition to the
pedlarmen remounted here tulip About a Dwight more pekin silvers 
are being shipped to White onste yard Not hearing from
you in regard to the Biscay militia I am preparing
French Waynes for the field & will send them fast
as Wayworn canby procured tulip The Dayton Baltic Webb wriggles
has been repeated from Brutus stick Lonesome thinks that Caldwell
Sprage more summer can safely be telegraph from Quotient torch
white yacht Chicago on the contrary is asking for venus
tulip Augusta at Lewis bug Job Norris Brown expected to
join Meriden at Stand on in about Clark libels pause
Mastiff has sent Saffrons to fraction to protect Floras pembroke
I doubt if he will be able to do much 
on Galway at present pekin moreover the Surgery would be
too late to help Flora stick The latter is in 
Soften of Allatona pass & is swindling against Flannel Comet
